scripts:
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content
create path (sling:Folder) /conf
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/translation/pages
create service user studio-translation-service
set ACL for studio-translation-service
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/translation
end
create service user studio-translation-worker
set ACL for studio-translation-worker
    allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:versionManagement,jcr:lockManagement on /content
    allow jcr:read on /conf
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/translation
end
create group translation-reviewers
add admin to group translation-reviewers
# The group had no name and no word about what it is for: Users listed a bare id among the roles.
set properties on authorizable(translation-reviewers)/profile
    default givenName{String} to "Translation reviewers"
    default aboutMe{String} to "Receive the review step of a translation in their Inbox. The group gives no rights of its own: reviewers who correct and approve are Authors as well."
end
